events.title: cPGuard Supply Chain Attack Pushes Backdoor Through Update Channel
events.summary: The cPGuard security product's update channel was compromised in a supply chain attack, distributing versions 5.88.12 through 5.88.19 that contained a backdoor affecting Linux servers. Users are advised to update to version 5.88.25 and rotate their credentials.
events.why_it_matters: A compromise of a security product's own update pipeline means servers running the backdoored versions may have an attacker-controlled foothold despite running protective software. The record marks the issue as critical and active, and recommends credential rotation in addition to updating. Note that the CVE listed in the record (CVE-2026-98432, CVSS 9.8) appears in a related post about Ubuntu kernel fixes rather than the cPGuard incident itself.
